description: checkout-api returning 5xx errors due to payments-db connection pool exhaustion during Black Friday traffic spike
root_cause: payments-db max_connections set to 20, insufficient for peak load. Connection pool depleted under sustained high-throughput checkout flow, causing all new payment requests to timeout.
resolution: Increased payments-db connection pool from 20 to 50, added PgBouncer connection pooler as middleware, implemented circuit breaker pattern on checkout-api side

description: order-service experiencing intermittent timeouts when querying payments-db during end-of-month batch processing
root_cause: End-of-month reconciliation batch job consumed 15 of 20 available connections for extended periods, starving real-time order queries. Batch and OLTP workloads competing for same connection pool.
resolution: Separated batch processing to read replica, reserved 5 connections exclusively for real-time queries using connection pool partitioning

description: notification-service memory leak after v1.8.0 deployment caused OOMKilled restarts every 30 minutes
root_cause: Version 1.8.0 introduced an email template caching layer that never evicted entries. Each unique email template was cached indefinitely, causing heap to grow linearly with request volume until OOM.
resolution: Rolled back to v1.7.3, fixed the cache to use LRU eviction with 500-entry cap, redeployed as v1.8.1 with memory monitoring alerts

description: user-service high CPU and degraded response times after v2.3.0 deployment with unoptimized database query
root_cause: New user search feature in v2.3.0 used a full table scan instead of indexed query for the /api/users/search endpoint. CPU spiked to 95% under normal traffic as the query was called on every keystroke.
resolution: Added composite index on (last_name, first_name, email), optimized query to use ILIKE with trigram index, added query timeout of 200ms

description: auth-service complete outage caused by redis-cache crash, cascading to all authenticated endpoints
root_cause: Redis maxmemory reached 4GB limit during a session storm (marketing campaign drove 3x normal signups). OOM killer terminated Redis process. auth-service had no fallback for session validation without Redis.
resolution: Increased Redis maxmemory to 8GB, implemented database-backed session fallback in auth-service, added Redis memory alerting at 70% and 85% thresholds

description: api-gateway elevated latency and intermittent 504 errors due to upstream CDN provider degradation
root_cause: CDN provider experienced routing issues in EU-West region, causing 40% of static asset requests to timeout. api-gateway health checks were passing (they hit /health, not CDN-dependent paths) masking the issue.
resolution: Waited for CDN provider resolution (2h), then implemented multi-CDN failover and added synthetic monitoring that tests CDN-dependent paths

description: checkout-api payment failures after configuration change reduced database query timeout from 5000ms to 500ms
root_cause: Operations team updated checkout-api config to reduce query timeout as part of a latency optimization initiative. The new 500ms timeout was too aggressive for complex payment verification queries that legitimately take 200-800ms under load.
resolution: Reverted timeout to 3000ms (compromise between old 5000ms and attempted 500ms), documented acceptable query time ranges per endpoint, added config change review requirement for timeout values

description: payments-db planned maintenance window caused 15-minute service degradation when failover took longer than expected
root_cause: Scheduled maintenance on primary payments-db node. Automatic failover to replica took 12 minutes instead of expected 30 seconds due to replication lag backlog. During failover, all write queries failed.
resolution: Implemented streaming replication monitoring, added pre-maintenance replication lag check (must be <100ms before proceeding), updated runbook with manual failover steps

description: Complete web-frontend outage when auth-service internal TLS certificate expired, breaking all inter-service HTTPS communication
root_cause: Internal TLS certificate for auth-service.internal expired after 1-year validity period. Certificate renewal was manual and no automated alerting existed for internal cert expiry. All services communicating with auth-service over mTLS immediately failed.
resolution: Renewed certificate manually (15 min to generate + deploy), implemented cert-manager for automatic renewal 30 days before expiry, added monitoring for all internal certificate expiry dates

description: auth-service intermittent 403 errors after IAM policy update restricted OAuth scope for service-to-service tokens
root_cause: Security team updated IAM policies to enforce least-privilege OAuth scopes. The change inadvertently removed the 'user:read' scope from service-to-service tokens used by checkout-api and user-service to call auth-service, causing sporadic 403 Forbidden errors.
resolution: Added missing 'user:read' scope back to service accounts, implemented policy-as-code review process requiring automated scope validation before IAM changes are applied
